[[File:Reward casket (beginner) detail.png|left|130px]]
A '''[[reward casket]] (beginner)''' is received after completing the final clue of a [[Clue scroll (beginner)|beginner clue scroll]] trail, and contains the final reward for the trail. Opening the reward casket is required for treasure trail completion to be tracked on the [[HiScores]] and [[collection log]].

The player can possess unlimited amounts of reward caskets up to the [[Stackable_items#Limit_of_a_stack|stack limit]]. Players are eligible to receive more clue scrolls regardless of how many reward caskets are in the player's posession.

The beginner reward casket, unlike other reward caskets, cannot be opened on Entrana. If players attempt to do so, the chatbox will state "''You cannot open this on Entrana, the monks are watching you too closely.''" Furthermore, accounts that are less than 10 hours old will not be able to receive any unique rewards from these caskets.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1418876325192929281|date=24 July 2021|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/106201|archivedate=22:34, 29 July 2021 (UTC)|quote=10 hours, applies to all accounts doing beginner clues.}}

==Rewards==
Beginner clues generate a minimum of 1 reward and a maximum of 3, granting an average of 2 rewards per casket. The rewards consist of generic items, and items that are unique for beginner clues. On average it will take 597 beginner clues to obtain every unique, not counting the black pickaxe which you can get from easy clues at a higher rate. 

All droprates are confirmed by [[Mod Tide]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Tide|url=https://twitter.com/JagexTide/status/1182709121566564355|date=11 October 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27964269|archivedate=31 July 2026|quote=Hey guys and gals, i'ts been 6 months since the release of beginner clues so I thought you might like to see what the drop rates are! Enjoy those cabbages, they taste great.|name=Clue rates tweet}} The listed rarities are per roll.

The average loot roll is worth {{Coins|floor({{BeginnerClueValue}})}}. On average, beginner clues are worth {{Coins|floor(2 * {{BeginnerClueValue}})}}.

===Beginner clue uniques===
*The chance to receive any unique is 1/24 per roll, with a specific unique being 1/360 per roll. Players obtain an average of 1 unique per 12 clue scrolls, and a specific unique an average of once per 180 clue scrolls.
